details: Receive admission letter (or conditional admission) from the university.
tips: Apply early to avoid visa-appointment rush.

details: Deposit EUR 11,904 (EUR 992 per month for 12 months) with a provider such as Expatrio, Fintiba or Coracle.
Buy public student insurance (TK, Barmer, AOK, DAK) or an approved visa-valid plan.
tips: Insurance proof is needed for visa and enrollment.

details: Book the visa appointment via the German mission's VFS Global center for your city.
tips: Peak season is June-September; book early.

details: Fill the national visa application form (Type D) and collect documents.
documents_needed: Passport, photos, APS, degree and transcripts, admission letter, blocked account proof, insurance, CV, motivation letter, language certificate
tips: Make an extra set of photocopies.

details: Submit documents and biometrics, pay the visa fee.
tips: Be ready to explain your study plan.

details: Embassy processes the application; you may get a request for extra documents.
tips: Do not book non-refundable flights before approval.

details: Fly to Germany with admission letter and original documents.
documents_needed: Passport with visa, admission letter, insurance, funds proof
tips: Arrive 1-2 weeks before the semester starts.

details: Register address (Anmeldung), enroll at the university, open a bank account, apply for a residence permit at the Foreigners Office.
documents_needed: Passport, rental contract, enrollment proof, insurance, photos
